problem_statement:
Default behaviour in `TextClassificationPipeline` for regression problem type
### Feature request

The `AutoModelForSequenceClassification` class also supports problem_type=regression. I am not sure if it is popularly used but I believe that function_to_apply in `TextClassificationPipeline` should behave as if it is set to "none"  for this case?

### Motivation

Currently, the "sigmoid" function is also applied for regression tasks which, in my opinion, might not be the correct default behaviour.

### Your contribution

I believe this can be handled by adding an additional condition for `self.model.config.problem_type == "regression"` before [this](https://github.com/huggingface/transformers/blob/38f9f10dd9240619ea17fb6c7acb51b3bc592232/src/transformers/pipelines/text_classification.py#L195) line.
